meta.description: LoRA on Krea 2 (raw) with quantization + low_vram for 24GB cards. Natural-language captions. For Krea 2 Turbo, switch the arch to krea2:turbo in the UI so the training adapter is applied. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged. STEP TABLE (meta.step_table, added 2026-10-12): 20 images ~1500, 30 images ~1500, 50 images ~1600, 100 images ~3200, then +20/image above 100 (200 images ~5200), capped at 6000. Source: the fork's per-arch advisor value exposure target for krea2 (steps/image incl. the size damping, i.e. what the exposure gauge calls on-target - before the arch's own maxSteps ceiling) at 20/30/50/100 images, floored at 1500, then +20 steps/image above 100, capped at 6000. Values are steps at effective batch 1 - the Step Suggestion panel and exposure gauge use this table while the preset is loaded and divide by your effective batch (batch_size x gradient_accumulation); below the first row the first row's steps apply.
